issue_request: FHIR-7497 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core technical correction for the profiling discriminator discussion. It requested fixing the incomplete sentence so systems determine which slice a list item corresponds to by checking whether the item's content meets the slice rules.
initial_application: The Jira comment records SVN revision #5348. In git, commit da0342e6f4cb7192598e1b84e186e36767e14138 applied @7497 by changing source/profiling.html from the incomplete 'which slice an item in the list by checking' wording to include 'corresponds to'.
additional_context: Later profiling-page edits changed the exact sentence. Commit a92e9170b12bcd8a8a46a4a84aa8d37af506a5ee briefly rephrased it, and commit c3c5f59e2d47f318df0abd2236c3ad28b2e95dd3 rewrote it to the current 'determine the slice corresponding to an item' form. source/profiling.html is the current Profiling FHIR page and is linked from source/documentation.html. Confluence and Zulip searches found no conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source/profiling.html:606-609 says systems can determine the slice corresponding to an item in the list by checking the item's content against the slice rules, which preserves the corrected meaning requested by FHIR-7497.
